preconditions.description: The number of employees n must be between 1 and 2000.

preconditions.expression: all(1 <= pi <= n or pi == -1 for pi in managers)
preconditions.description: Each manager index pi must be either -1 or a valid employee number between 1 and n.
The number of manager entries must equal the number of employees n.

postconditions.description: The output must be the number of groups formed, which is the length of the groups list.

postconditions.expression: all(not any(is_superior(a, b) for b in group) for a in group for group in groups)
postconditions.description: Within any group, no employee should be the superior of another employee.

postconditions.expression: all(employee in any(group for group in groups) for employee in range(1, n + 1))
postconditions.description: Every employee must belong to exactly one group.
